selectionOutcomes.description: ShareLinkViewSet uses IsAuthenticated and PaperlessObjectPermissions, and delegates creation to the configured ShareLinkSerializer.
The serializer context may receive the authenticated request user, which can affect document-target validation.
The ShareLinkViewSet uses PaperlessObjectPermissions, with object filtering configured for the share-link resource.
POST requires the model add permission, while object permission handling is defined separately.
Object-level permission checks defer to the superclass for non-owners rather than treating a global grant as owner access.
The request user is passed into serializers that support permission-aware validation.
Share-link creation validates the referenced document and denies creation unless the user has the required global view permission and the owner-aware object check succeeds.
The owner-aware helper permits the owner or an explicit object permission, rather than relying solely on the global permission.
